messages:
sam: quick pulse 1 1 1 ran a short synthetic-vs-summarization probe comparing quantized variants on multi-doc synthesis. posting compact numbers + a safety-aware rollout suggestion.
marta: drop the TL;DR numbers and any sample failure notes pls.
sam: snapshot (slice=multi-doc-synth, avg input ~1k tokens, N=400):
```
- p95 latency: fp16 210ms | int8 250ms
- throughput (tok/s): fp16 0.93 | int8 0.40
- cost per 1k tokens: fp16 $0.0086 | int8 $0.0037
- factuality proxy (golded span-precision): fp16 84.2% | int8 77.5%  (delta -6.7pp)
- hallucination heuristic rate: fp16 1.5% | int8 7.0%
- sample notes: hallucinations often appear when prompts ask for source attribution across 3+ docs
```
link: https://internal.redwood/sparkbench/synth-probe/3301239876
ryan: econ quick take 1 ~2.3x token savings. for content-heavy customers that maps to major monthly cost wins but a ~6.7pp factuality drop is material for trust/revenue-sensitive flows.
devin: safety/ops mitigation ideas: a) mirrored-probe (no user impact) to collect paired outputs b) gated canary with an automated safety-check that falls back to fp16 c) token-chunk hybrid for priming segments. pseudocode for gate below.
```
# safety gate pseudocode
if multi_doc_count >= 2 and request.tokens > 600:
  mirror -> fp16 (store paired output)
  if safety_check(int8_output) fails:
    serve -> fp16
    increment safety_fallback_counter
else:
  serve -> int8
```
sam: proposed rollout: 1) 48h mirrored probe for 100% of multi-doc synth (store paired outputs + nightly golden eval) 2) 3% live canary with safety gate enabled (int8 default, safe-fail -> fp16) 3) auto-escalate if hallucination rate delta >3pp for 6h -> expand fp16 to all multi-doc synth and page #product + #eng-ml
marta: product note: multi-doc synth is ~6% of calls but ~60% of GTN demo/enterprise workflows. small fraction but high exposure. need GTN slides with unit-econ delta and retention sensitivity scenarios.
dryan: i'll draft the econ slide: cost delta, 3 churn sensitivity scenarios, and fallback cost.
devin: ops note: mirrored probe will need storage for paired outputs and nightly eval job; i'll wire an automated safety_check that approximates factuality proxy (span-precision) and a simple hallucination heuristic. default thresholds: factuality_delta > 3.0pp or hallucination_delta > 2.5pp -> trigger fallback.
safety-bot: safety-check: mirrored-probe job queued (id=3301239876-mirror), nightly-eval hook enabled. See https://internal.redwood/deploys/3301239876
marta: ack. once 24h mirror data is in, we'll reconvene and decide whether chunked-decode or stricter routing is the right long-term play. sam, please post a couple of anonymized failure examples to help GTN/ops. :white_check_mark:
